---
title: "Strongest eIF3d-promoted mRNAs in hypoxia, both cell lines"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
params:
  padj: 0.05
  min_lfc_both: 1
  n_top: 2
  highlight: ""
  controls: ""
  controls_label: "Pos controls from Roiuk et al"
  controls_tx: ""
  neg_controls: ""
  neg_controls_label: "Negative control"
---

**Question.** Which mRNAs does eIF3d promote most strongly in hypoxia in **both** MDA-MB-231
and MCF7-SIX1, and where do they sit against the whole transcriptome when hypoxia TE change is
plotted against normoxia TE change?

**Ranking rule (Kate, 2026-11-19: hypoxia only, with the weight on the size of the fold change).**
Contrast: si3d knockdown, hypoxia 1hr, in each cell line. A gene qualifies if its TE change is
significant in both lines (`te_padj` < `params$padj`) and its TE LFC is at least
`params$min_lfc_both` in **both** lines (the floor). Qualifying genes are ranked by the **mean** of
the two TE LFCs, so a larger fold change ranks higher; the floor stops one line carrying a gene
that is weak in the other. The top `params$n_top` are highlighted. Setting `params$highlight` to
comma-separated symbols (e.g. `"HERPUD1,TBPL1,RPP14,AGPAT1"`) highlights those genes instead,
whether or not they pass the ranking rule; outputs then carry the symbols in their filenames.
`params$controls` adds a second group (e.g. `"BCL2L12,TPRA1"`, the positive controls from the
Teleman set 1 list in `POSITIVE_CONTROLS.md`) to the normoxia-vs-hypoxia scatter only, in
Okabe-Ito dark blue, since orange and sky blue are reserved for eIF3d and eIF3e.
`params$neg_controls` (e.g. `"ACTB"`) adds negative controls the same way, in black.
`params$controls_tx` (e.g. `"TPRA1=ENST00000296210"`) pins a control to one transcript in the
region density plots, in both cell lines, instead of each line's expressed transcript - used for
TPRA1 so the plots show the 315-nt 5'UTR tested in the Teleman data (set 1), which is what a reporter
would carry. Its region lengths and GC come from `transcript_length_gc.R`
(`output/finding_positive_controls/transcript_length_gc.csv`, GENCODE v49). Normoxia plays no part in the
ranking; it is only the x axis of the plot.

**Direction.** All LFCs are log2(sictrl / si3d), so positive = knockdown lowers TE = eIF3d
promotes. MCF7-SIX1 files are already negated to match (asserted below). LFCs are
apeglm-shrunken in every file, so low-count genes do not dominate a ranking by magnitude.

**Normoxia contrast.** MDA-MB-231: normoxia 1+4hr, time-regressed. MCF7-SIX1: normoxia 1hr (the
only one it has).

**TE is gene-level.** A top gene here still needs the isoform / 5'UTR check
(`02_bcl2l12_5utr_check.Rmd`) before it is a reporter candidate.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (!exists("params") || !is.list(params)) {
  params <- list(padj = 0.05, min_lfc_both = 1, n_top = 2, highlight = "",
                 controls = "", controls_label = "Pos controls from Roiuk et al",
                 neg_controls = "", neg_controls_label = "Negative control", controls_tx = "")
}
library(tidyverse); library(here); library(ggrepel)
kd_orange <- "#E69F00"
out_dir <- here("output", "finding_positive_controls")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## 1. Load TE and check direction

```{r load}
read_te <- function(f) read_csv(
  here("output", paste0("translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_", f, ".csv")),
  show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))

files <- c(mda231_hypoxia    = "hypoxia_1hr",
           mda231_normoxia   = "normoxia_1and4hr",
           mcf7six1_hypoxia  = "mcf7six1_hypoxia_1hr",
           mcf7six1_normoxia = "mcf7six1_normoxia_1hr")
te <- map(files, read_te)

# 231: the siRNA depletes EIF3D's own mRNA, so its rna_lfc must be strongly positive
for (k in c("mda231_hypoxia", "mda231_normoxia")) {
  e <- te[[k]]$rna_lfc[te[[k]]$symbol == "EIF3D"]
  cat(sprintf("%s: EIF3D rna_lfc = %.2f\n", k, e))
  stopifnot("231 direction flipped" = e > 1.5)
}
# MCF7-SIX1 files carry no rna_lfc: assert the negation, and EIF3D's own TE sign
# (raw TE of the depleted factor is positive, so the negated value is negative)
for (k in c("mcf7six1_hypoxia", "mcf7six1_normoxia")) {
  d <- te[[k]]
  stopifnot("MCF7-SIX1 te_lfc is not the negated source LFC" =
              isTRUE(all.equal(d$te_lfc, -d$source_log2FoldChange)))
  e <- d$te_lfc[d$symbol == "EIF3D"]
  cat(sprintf("%s: EIF3D te_lfc = %.2f\n", k, e))
  stopifnot("MCF7-SIX1 direction check failed" = e < -0.5)
}
walk(te, ~ stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(.x$gene_id_clean), all(is.finite(na.omit(.x$te_lfc)))))
```

## 2. Rank: hypoxia 1hr, both lines

```{r rank}
hyp <- te$mda231_hypoxia %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol, lfc_231 = te_lfc, padj_231 = te_padj) %>%
  inner_join(te$mcf7six1_hypoxia %>%
               dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, lfc_mcf = te_lfc, padj_mcf = te_padj,
                             baseMean_mcf = baseMean),
             by = "gene_id_clean")
cat("genes tested at hypoxia 1hr in both lines:", nrow(hyp), "\n")

ranked <- hyp %>%
  filter(padj_231 < params$padj, padj_mcf < params$padj,
         lfc_231 >= params$min_lfc_both, lfc_mcf >= params$min_lfc_both) %>%
  mutate(mean_lfc = (lfc_231 + lfc_mcf) / 2) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_lfc)) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number())
cat("qualify (padj <", params$padj, "and TE LFC >=", params$min_lfc_both, "in both):",
    nrow(ranked), "\n")
stopifnot(nrow(ranked) >= params$n_top)

top <- ranked %>% slice_head(n = params$n_top)
# Optional hand-picked genes (Kate, 2026-11-20). Taken from all genes tested in both lines,
# not from `ranked`, so a gene below the floor (e.g. AGPAT1, MCF7-SIX1 0.73) can still be shown.
hl_syms <- trimws(strsplit(params$highlight, ",")[[1]])
hl_syms <- hl_syms[hl_syms != ""]
if (length(hl_syms)) {
  top <- hyp %>% filter(symbol %in% hl_syms) %>%
    mutate(mean_lfc = (lfc_231 + lfc_mcf) / 2) %>%
    arrange(match(symbol, hl_syms))
  stopifnot("a highlight symbol is not tested at hypoxia 1hr in both lines (or is duplicated)" =
              identical(top$symbol, hl_syms))
}
out_tag <- if (length(hl_syms)) paste0("_", paste(hl_syms, collapse = "_")) else ""
ctrl_syms <- trimws(strsplit(params$controls, ",")[[1]])
ctrl_syms <- ctrl_syms[ctrl_syms != ""]
stopifnot("a gene is in both highlight and controls" = !any(ctrl_syms %in% top$symbol))
if (length(ctrl_syms)) out_tag <- paste0(out_tag, "_ctrl_", paste(ctrl_syms, collapse = "_"))
neg_syms <- trimws(strsplit(params$neg_controls, ",")[[1]])
neg_syms <- neg_syms[neg_syms != ""]
stopifnot("a gene is in neg_controls and another group" = !any(neg_syms %in% c(top$symbol, ctrl_syms)))
if (length(neg_syms)) out_tag <- paste0(out_tag, "_neg_", paste(neg_syms, collapse = "_"))
ranked %>% slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  mutate(across(c(lfc_231, lfc_mcf, mean_lfc), ~ round(.x, 2)),
         across(c(padj_231, padj_mcf), ~ signif(.x, 2)),
         baseMean_mcf = round(baseMean_mcf)) %>%
  dplyr::select(rank, symbol, mean_lfc, lfc_231, padj_231, lfc_mcf, padj_mcf, baseMean_mcf) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Top 15 by mean hypoxia 1hr TE LFC (log2 sictrl / si3d)")
```

For comparison, ranking the same qualifying genes by the **smaller** of the two LFCs (which
rewards balance between the lines rather than size):

```{r rank_min}
ranked %>% mutate(min_lfc = pmin(lfc_231, lfc_mcf)) %>% arrange(desc(min_lfc)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>% transmute(symbol, min_lfc = round(min_lfc, 2),
                                  mean_lfc = round(mean_lfc, 2), mean_rank = rank) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r save_rank}
write_csv(ranked, file.path(out_dir, "04_top_eif3d_targets_hypoxia_both_lines.csv"))
```

## 3. Where the top genes sit: normoxia vs hypoxia TE change

```{r plot_data}
line_df <- function(line, label) {
  te[[paste0(line, "_normoxia")]] %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol, x = te_lfc) %>%
    inner_join(te[[paste0(line, "_hypoxia")]] %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, y = te_lfc),
               by = "gene_id_clean") %>%
    filter(!is.na(x), !is.na(y)) %>%
    mutate(cell_line = label)
}
pd <- bind_rows(line_df("mda231",   "MDA-MB-231"),
                line_df("mcf7six1", "MCF7-SIX1")) %>%
  mutate(cell_line = factor(cell_line, levels = c("MDA-MB-231", "MCF7-SIX1")))

hl <- pd %>% filter(gene_id_clean %in% top$gene_id_clean)
stopifnot("a top gene is missing from a normoxia file" = nrow(hl) == 2 * nrow(top))
neg <- pd %>% filter(symbol %in% neg_syms)
stopifnot("a negative control is missing from a cell line (or duplicated)" =
            nrow(neg) == 2 * length(neg_syms))
ctrl <- pd %>% filter(symbol %in% ctrl_syms)
stopifnot("a control gene is missing from a cell line (or its symbol is duplicated)" =
            nrow(ctrl) == 2 * length(ctrl_syms))
lab_pts <- bind_rows(hl %>% mutate(group = "Selected eIF3d targets"),
                     ctrl %>% mutate(group = params$controls_label),
                     neg %>% mutate(group = params$neg_controls_label)) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Selected eIF3d targets", params$controls_label,
                                          params$neg_controls_label)))
group_cols <- setNames(c(kd_orange, "#0072B2", "black"), levels(lab_pts$group))

stats <- pd %>% group_by(cell_line) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), r = cor(x, y), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(lab = sprintf("Pearson R = %.2f, n = %s", r, format(n, big.mark = ",")))
stats %>% knitr::kable(digits = 3)

x_lab <- c("MDA-MB-231" = "normoxia 1+4hr (time-regressed)", "MCF7-SIX1" = "normoxia 1hr")
hl %>% transmute(cell_line, symbol, normoxia_te_lfc = round(x, 2),
                 hypoxia_te_lfc = round(y, 2)) %>% knitr::kable()
```

```{r plot, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5}
# Zoom to the central 99.8% of genes on each axis (always keeping the highlighted genes in
# view); a handful of extreme genes otherwise stretch the axes to +/-15 and squash the density.
# Zooming with coord_equal() does not drop data, so R still uses every gene.
lims <- range(quantile(c(pd$x, pd$y), c(0.001, 0.999)), lab_pts$x, lab_pts$y) + c(-0.25, 0.25)
n_out <- sum(pd$x < lims[1] | pd$x > lims[2] | pd$y < lims[1] | pd$y > lims[2])
cat(sprintf("view: %.2f to %.2f; %d gene-points fall outside it (both panels)\n",
            lims[1], lims[2], n_out))
p <- ggplot(pd, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_point(colour = "grey70", size = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(data = lab_pts, aes(colour = group), size = 2.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = group_cols, name = NULL) +
  geom_text_repel(data = lab_pts, aes(label = symbol), colour = "black", size = 4,
                  min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.6, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 9) +
  geom_text(data = stats, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.4, size = 3.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ cell_line, labeller = labeller(cell_line = function(s)
    paste0(s, "\nx: ", x_lab[s]))) +
  coord_equal(xlim = lims, ylim = lims) +
  labs(x = "TE log2 fold change, normoxia (log2 sictrl / si3d)",
       y = "TE log2 fold change, hypoxia 1hr (log2 sictrl / si3d)",
       title = if (length(hl_syms)) "Selected eIF3d-promoted mRNAs in hypoxia, both cell lines" else
         sprintf("Top %d eIF3d-promoted mRNAs in hypoxia, both cell lines", params$n_top),
       subtitle = "Positive = eIF3d promotes translation. Grey: all genes") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = if (length(c(ctrl_syms, neg_syms))) "bottom" else "none")
p
ggsave(here("plots", paste0("finding_positive_controls_04_top_targets_te_normoxia_vs_hypoxia", out_tag, ".pdf")),
       p, width = 10, height = 5)
```

## 3b. Same genes, mRNA change: normoxia vs hypoxia

The same layout as section 3, with the **mRNA** log2 fold change (RNA-seq, sictrl / si3d) in
place of TE, to show whether each gene's mRNA level also moves on eIF3d knockdown. Both lines
use apeglm-shrunken LFCs: MDA-MB-231 `rna_lfc` from the same TE files; MCF7-SIX1
`rna_lfc_shrunk` from `00_mcf7six1_hypoxia_si3d_categories.Rmd` (knit once per condition), whose
TE files carry no RNA column.

**MDA-MB-231 mRNA is spike-in normalized and knockdown lowers total mRNA per cell**, so its cloud
sits above zero on both axes (median `rna_lfc` 0.41 at hypoxia 1hr, 0.51 at normoxia 1+4hr; see
CLAUDE.md). A gene at the cloud's centre there is typical, not unchanged. MCF7-SIX1 is not
spike-in normalized and centres near zero.

```{r plot_rna_data}
mcf_rna <- function(cond) {
  f <- here("output", "finding_positive_controls",
            paste0("mcf7six1_", cond, "_1hr_si3d_rna_ribo_te_categories.csv"))
  stopifnot("knit 00_mcf7six1_hypoxia_si3d_categories.Rmd for this condition first" = file.exists(f))
  read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id), symbol, rna_lfc = rna_lfc_shrunk)
}
mcf_rna_n <- mcf_rna("normoxia"); mcf_rna_h <- mcf_rna("hypoxia")
# direction: si3d depletes EIF3D mRNA, so its promotes-positive RNA LFC must be large and positive
for (d in list(mcf_rna_n, mcf_rna_h)) stopifnot("MCF7-SIX1 RNA direction" = d$rna_lfc[d$symbol == "EIF3D"] > 1.5)

pd_rna <- bind_rows(
  te$mda231_normoxia %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol, x = rna_lfc) %>%
    inner_join(te$mda231_hypoxia %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, y = rna_lfc), by = "gene_id_clean") %>%
    mutate(cell_line = "MDA-MB-231"),
  mcf_rna_n %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol, x = rna_lfc) %>%
    inner_join(mcf_rna_h %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, y = rna_lfc), by = "gene_id_clean") %>%
    mutate(cell_line = "MCF7-SIX1")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(x), !is.na(y)) %>%
  mutate(cell_line = factor(cell_line, levels = c("MDA-MB-231", "MCF7-SIX1")))

lab_rna <- lab_pts %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, cell_line, group) %>%
  inner_join(pd_rna, by = c("gene_id_clean", "cell_line"))
stopifnot("a labelled gene has no RNA LFC in one line" = nrow(lab_rna) == nrow(lab_pts))

stats_rna <- pd_rna %>% group_by(cell_line) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), r = cor(x, y), med_x = median(x), med_y = median(y), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(lab = sprintf("Pearson R = %.2f, n = %s", r, format(n, big.mark = ",")))
stats_rna %>% knitr::kable(digits = 3)
lab_rna %>% transmute(cell_line, symbol, group, normoxia_rna_lfc = round(x, 2),
                      hypoxia_rna_lfc = round(y, 2)) %>% arrange(cell_line, group) %>% knitr::kable()
```

```{r plot_rna, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5}
# EIF3D itself (~+3 to +4) is the extreme the 99.8% zoom exists to exclude; labelled genes stay in view
lims_r <- range(quantile(c(pd_rna$x, pd_rna$y), c(0.001, 0.999)), lab_rna$x, lab_rna$y) + c(-0.25, 0.25)
p_rna <- ggplot(pd_rna, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_point(colour = "grey70", size = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(data = lab_rna, aes(colour = group), size = 2.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = group_cols, name = NULL) +
  geom_text_repel(data = lab_rna, aes(label = symbol), colour = "black", size = 4,
                  min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.6, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 9) +
  geom_text(data = stats_rna, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.4, size = 3.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ cell_line, labeller = labeller(cell_line = function(s)
    paste0(s, "\nx: ", x_lab[s]))) +
  coord_equal(xlim = lims_r, ylim = lims_r) +
  labs(x = "mRNA log2 fold change, normoxia (log2 sictrl / si3d)",
       y = "mRNA log2 fold change, hypoxia 1hr (log2 sictrl / si3d)",
       title = "mRNA change on eIF3d knockdown, same genes",
       subtitle = "Positive = mRNA lower after knockdown. Grey: all genes. MDA-MB-231 is spike-in normalized") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = if (length(c(ctrl_syms, neg_syms))) "bottom" else "none")
p_rna
ggsave(here("plots", paste0("finding_positive_controls_04_top_targets_rna_normoxia_vs_hypoxia", out_tag, ".pdf")),
       p_rna, width = 10, height = 5)
```

## 4. Length and GC by mRNA region: top genes against expressed genes and eIF3d targets

Each cell line uses its own feature matrix, built on the transcript **that line expresses**
(MDA-MB-231: `feature_matrix_tco.rds`; MCF7-SIX1: `feature_matrix_tco_mcf7six1.rds`), so a
gene's transcript can differ between the two rows. **One exception, ACTB in MCF7-SIX1:** that matrix lists
ENST00000425660, which carries 0.1% of ACTB mRNA and is an artifact of the GENCODE v26 / v49
mismatch (see `POSITIVE_CONTROLS.md`, ACTB). Its 5'UTR matches MANE but its CDS (378 nt) and 3'UTR
(1,383 nt) do not, so ACTB's MCF7-SIX1 row is replaced by the MANE transcript ENST00000646664 (the
mRNA both lines actually express), taken from the MDA-MB-231 matrix where it is the selected
transcript. Region features are sequence-derived, so they do not depend on the cell line. **Expressed genes** = genes in that matrix that
were also tested for TE in that line at hypoxia 1hr. **eIF3d-promoted** = that line's existing
gene set (hypoxia 1hr, TE LFC > 0.5, padj < 0.05). Grey is every other expressed gene, so the
two groups do not overlap. Dashed lines mark the selected genes in their scatter colour: orange for
the eIF3d targets, dark blue for `params$controls`, black for `params$neg_controls`. A control
pinned by `params$controls_tx` shows that transcript in both panels. One figure per
region (5'UTR, CDS, 3'UTR), each built by the same function.

```{r region_data}
mats <- c("MDA-MB-231" = "feature_matrix_tco.rds",
          "MCF7-SIX1"  = "feature_matrix_tco_mcf7six1.rds")
gsets <- c("MDA-MB-231" = "hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv",
           "MCF7-SIX1"  = "mcf7six1_hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv")
tested <- list("MDA-MB-231" = te$mda231_hypoxia$gene_id_clean[!is.na(te$mda231_hypoxia$te_padj)],
               "MCF7-SIX1"  = te$mcf7six1_hypoxia$gene_id_clean[!is.na(te$mcf7six1_hypoxia$te_padj)])
regions <- c(utr5 = "5'UTR", cds = "CDS", utr3 = "3'UTR")

fm <- imap_dfr(mats, function(f, line) {
  m <- readRDS(here("output", "translational_control_overview", f)) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, transcript_id_clean, symbol,
                  all_of(paste0(names(regions), "_length")), all_of(paste0(names(regions), "_gc")))
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(m$gene_id_clean))
  if (line == "MCF7-SIX1") {
    mane <- readRDS(here("output", "translational_control_overview", mats[["MDA-MB-231"]])) %>%
      filter(symbol == "ACTB") %>% dplyr::select(all_of(names(m)))
    stopifnot("ACTB override: expected the v26 artifact in MCF7-SIX1 and MANE in 231" =
                m$transcript_id_clean[m$symbol == "ACTB"] == "ENST00000425660",
              nrow(mane) == 1, mane$transcript_id_clean == "ENST00000646664")
    m <- bind_rows(m %>% filter(symbol != "ACTB"), mane)
  }
  gs <- read_csv(here("output", "genesets", gsets[[line]]), show_col_types = FALSE)$ensembl_gene
  m %>% filter(gene_id_clean %in% tested[[line]]) %>%
    mutate(cell_line = line,
           group = if_else(gene_id_clean %in% gs, "eIF3d promoted", "All other expressed genes"))
}) %>%
  mutate(cell_line = factor(cell_line, levels = names(mats)))
for (r in names(regions)) {
  stopifnot(all(fm[[paste0(r, "_gc")]] >= 0 & fm[[paste0(r, "_gc")]] <= 100, na.rm = TRUE))
}
```

```{r region_fn}
region_figure <- function(r) {
  rlab <- regions[[r]]
  ud <- fm %>% transmute(cell_line, group, gene_id_clean, symbol, transcript_id_clean,
                         length_nt = .data[[paste0(r, "_length")]],
                         gc = .data[[paste0(r, "_gc")]]) %>%
    filter(length_nt > 0, !is.na(gc)) %>%
    mutate(log2_length = log2(length_nt))

  top_r <- ud %>% filter(gene_id_clean %in% top$gene_id_clean)
  stopifnot("a top gene is missing this region in a cell line's matrix" =
              nrow(top_r) == 2 * nrow(top))
  neg_r <- ud %>% filter(symbol %in% neg_syms)
  stopifnot("a negative control is missing this region in a cell line's matrix" =
              nrow(neg_r) == 2 * length(neg_syms))
  ctrl_r <- ud %>% filter(symbol %in% ctrl_syms)
  stopifnot("a positive control is missing this region in a cell line's matrix" =
              nrow(ctrl_r) == 2 * length(ctrl_syms))
  # pinned transcripts (params$controls_tx): same transcript in both lines, from transcript_length_gc.csv
  pins <- trimws(strsplit(params$controls_tx, ",")[[1]]); pins <- pins[pins != ""]
  if (length(pins)) {
    pin <- tibble(symbol = sub("=.*", "", pins), pin_tx = sub(".*=", "", pins))
    stopifnot("controls_tx names a gene that is not in controls" = all(pin$symbol %in% ctrl_syms))
    tlg <- read_csv(here("output", "finding_positive_controls", "transcript_length_gc.csv"),
                    show_col_types = FALSE) %>% filter(region == r)
    pin <- pin %>% left_join(tlg, by = c("pin_tx" = "transcript_id_clean"))
    stopifnot("a pinned transcript is not in transcript_length_gc.csv; run transcript_length_gc.R on it" =
                !anyNA(pin$length_nt))
    ctrl_r <- ctrl_r %>% left_join(pin %>% dplyr::select(symbol, pin_tx, pin_len = length_nt, pin_gc = gc_pct),
                                   by = "symbol") %>%
      mutate(transcript_id_clean = coalesce(pin_tx, transcript_id_clean),
             length_nt = coalesce(as.numeric(pin_len), as.numeric(length_nt)),
             gc = coalesce(pin_gc, gc), log2_length = log2(length_nt)) %>%
      dplyr::select(-pin_tx, -pin_len, -pin_gc)
  }
  # lines and labels take the scatter colours: targets orange, negative controls black
  mark_r <- bind_rows(top_r %>% mutate(role = "eIF3d target", line_col = kd_orange),
                      ctrl_r %>% mutate(role = "positive control", line_col = "#0072B2"),
                      neg_r %>% mutate(role = "negative control", line_col = "black"))
  # percentile of each top gene among all expressed genes in that line
  tab <- mark_r %>% rowwise() %>%
    mutate(length_pctile = round(100 * mean(ud$length_nt[ud$cell_line == cell_line] <= length_nt)),
           gc_pctile     = round(100 * mean(ud$gc[ud$cell_line == cell_line] <= gc))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    transmute(cell_line, role, symbol, transcript_id_clean, length_nt, gc = round(gc, 1),
              length_pctile, gc_pctile)

  long <- ud %>% pivot_longer(c(log2_length, gc), names_to = "feature", values_to = "value")
  top_long <- mark_r %>% pivot_longer(c(log2_length, gc), names_to = "feature", values_to = "value") %>%
    # within each panel, one label per row, stacked in order of value so neighbouring lines never
    # share a row; every label starts just right of its own line, so it cannot be read as the
    # label of the line to its left (the top genes sit mid-distribution, never at the right edge)
    group_by(cell_line, feature) %>%
    mutate(row = rank(value, ties.method = "first"),
           vj  = 1.3 + 1.3 * (row - 1),
           hj  = -0.04) %>%
    ungroup()
  feat_lab <- c(log2_length = sprintf("log2 %s length (nt)", rlab), gc = sprintf("%s GC (%%)", rlab))
  long$feature <- factor(long$feature, levels = names(feat_lab))
  top_long$feature <- factor(top_long$feature, levels = names(feat_lab))

  wil <- long %>% group_by(cell_line, feature) %>%
    summarise(p = wilcox.test(value[group == "eIF3d promoted"],
                              value[group != "eIF3d promoted"])$p.value,
              n_set = sum(group == "eIF3d promoted"), n_bg = sum(group != "eIF3d promoted"),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    # the test goes in the panel header, where neither the dashed lines nor a label box can
    # cover it or the curves
    mutate(panel = sprintf("%s, %s\nWilcoxon p = %.2g; n = %d promoted, %s other", cell_line,
                           feat_lab[as.character(feature)], p, n_set, trimws(format(n_bg, big.mark = ','))),
           panel = factor(panel, levels = panel[order(cell_line, feature)]))
  long     <- long     %>% left_join(wil %>% dplyr::select(cell_line, feature, panel), by = c("cell_line", "feature"))
  top_long <- top_long %>% left_join(wil %>% dplyr::select(cell_line, feature, panel), by = c("cell_line", "feature"))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(long$panel), !anyNA(top_long$panel))

  p <- ggplot(long, aes(value, colour = group)) +
    geom_density(fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(data = top_long, aes(xintercept = value), linetype = "dashed",
               colour = top_long$line_col) +
    # white-backed so the dashed lines of neighbouring genes do not run through the text
    geom_label(data = top_long, aes(x = value, y = Inf, label = symbol, hjust = hj, vjust = vj),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.2, fill = "white", label.size = 0,
               colour = top_long$line_col,
               label.padding = unit(0.08, "lines")) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12 + 0.1 * (nrow(top) + length(ctrl_syms) + length(neg_syms))))) +
    facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free", nrow = 2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("All other expressed genes" = "grey70",
                                   "eIF3d promoted" = kd_orange)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Density", colour = NULL,
         title = sprintf("%s of the top eIF3d-promoted mRNAs, hypoxia 1hr", rlab),
         subtitle = if (length(c(ctrl_syms, neg_syms)))
           paste0("Dashed: orange = selected eIF3d targets, blue = positive controls",
                  if (length(pins)) paste0(" (", paste(sub("=", " ", pins), collapse = ", "), " in both lines)") else "",
                  ",\nblack = negative controls") else
           "Each cell line on its own expressed transcript. Dashed: selected genes") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  ggsave(here("plots", sprintf("finding_positive_controls_04_top_targets_%s_length_gc%s.pdf", r, out_tag)),
         p, width = 10, height = 7)
  list(plot = p, top = tab, wilcox = wil %>% dplyr::select(cell_line, feature, n_set, n_bg, p))
}
figs <- map(set_names(names(regions)), region_figure)
```
